test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 03 Jul, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

She ________ gracefully and greeted the interview committee with respect.
solution:
The correct answer is '**smiled**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**smiled**" means to express pleasure, favour, or amusement through a facial expression. (मुस्कुराया)
 
• When someone greets an interview committee, a respectful and pleasant expression, like a smile, is appropriate.
 
• The other options: "**leered**," "**grinned**," and "**smirked**" have connotations that are less appropriate or imply meanings that do not fit the context.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *She smiled__ gracefully and greeted the interview committee with respect.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Leered (मलिन दृष्टि से देखना)**: means to look or gaze in an unpleasant, malicious, or lascivious way.
 
• **Grinned (हंसी हंसी दिखाना)**: means to smile broadly, often in an informal or mockingly humorous manner.
 
• **Smirked (व्यंग्य हंसी करना)**: means to smile in a self-satisfied, smug, or conceited way.
